name: tools-research
description: Research beyond a normal web search: papers from OpenAlex, Substack posts, Reddit through your own free app, and YouTube consensus, written into a findings ledger with a link and an honest confidence label on every finding.

reddit_client_id.title: Reddit app id
reddit_client_id.description: From your own free Reddit app (reddit.com/prefs/apps, type script). Optional: only Reddit needs it.

reddit_client_secret.title: Reddit app secret
reddit_client_secret.description: The secret of that same app. Stored in your keychain.

openalex_email.title: Your email for OpenAlex (optional)
openalex_email.description: OpenAlex answers faster for callers who give a contact email. Leave blank to stay anonymous.
